summary: Recent changes to the autoplay functionality in Firefox focus on improving user control over media playback. The browser now **prevents videos with sound from playing automatically when audio sessions are interrupted**, ensuring a less disruptive experience. Additionally, autoplay requests are now delayed if permissions are still being processed, giving users more time to decide without unexpected media starting up. The update also allows touch input to automatically signal user activation for media playback, enhancing how users interact with websites. These adjustments are aimed at creating a more seamless browsing experience while respecting user preferences for autoplay.
